accountTopology.choice: one private database + owned payload directory per native account within v2 epoch
accountTopology.accountId: native random opaque reference, bound only after validated official account evidence
accountTopology.dedupScope: same account only; digest is content integrity/dedup, not authentication
accountTopology.legacyCompatibility: no v1 schema/data migration; unknown future schema locks recovery/upgrade, never silently clears

objectPlacement.small: SQLite BLOB, not a separate tiny file
objectPlacement.large: owned immutable payload file keyed by native generated object ref, no caller path
objectPlacement.why: host tiny-body DB/raw/deflate and file-allocation model show per-message files/always-compress can increase space
objectPlacement.fileAllocationNotClaimed: 4KiB tiny-file number is a model, Android filesystem overhead must be measured

codecPolicy.defaultCandidate: Deflate9 for larger compressible body records, subject to actual Android latency budget; Deflate6 remains fallback when savings insufficient vs cost
codecPolicy.selection: keep RAW unless compressed representation saves at least max(32 bytes,5 percent) after actual required framing; never compress encrypted/random data blindly
codecPolicy.gzip: baseline comparison only; separate GZIP wrapper not required for private objects
codecPolicy.zstd: not added to product; current synthetic host advantage modest and no Android ABI/package/maintenance proof
codecPolicy.optionalFutureAdmission: meaningful representative extra space or CPU benefit plus Android peak memory/read latency/recovery/ABI/size/license/security evidence, not algorithm name
codecPolicy.dedup: hash original bytes before compression/encryption, reuse only exact verified existing same-account object
codecPolicy.integrity: lossless original bytes/length/digest; no whitespace/HTML stripping to improve ratio
codecPolicy.encryption: compression before selective encryption; encryption framing/key custody/recovery remains separate required design, benchmark excludes it
codecPolicy.decode: stream with accepted original-size policy and codec tag; reject unknown codec/version/corrupt/truncated/oversize data, never allocate by untrusted declared length

tables.constraint: database opened only after epoch/source gate; account mapping cannot be replaced by payload claims
body reference same-account object; header data is private, not ordinary telemetry
RAW/ZLIB supported tags; INLINE has payload<=65536 and no file key; FILE has native owned key and no inline payload; lengths/refcount nonnegative
name/MIME never grants executable/path trust; only admitted local owned target or explicit user save URI
advance in same DB transaction as item/object refs; cursor is private
exact target journal; no arbitrary recursive public directory deletion
metadata fast query baseline; body search cancellable streaming or justified platform index; index costs included

inline: hash/compress to bounded staging; choose RAW/DEFLATE
apply required encryption/integrity framing without truncation
at serialized commit recheck gate/fence/account revision
one SQLite transaction inserts/reuses object, switches item refs, counts, index/cursor
external: write unique owned staging object, lossless digest/length/codec verification
finish/flush owned immutable object before DB references it
transaction switches refs/index/cursor after rechecking generation
old ref/object retained if failure; newly orphaned object only conservative GC later

gcRules: refcount is a cache, uncertainty never authorizes delete
verify no message/attachment refs AND no reader/writer/task leases before deleting exact owned object
decrement refs transactionally; delete object only after reference commit
source/cleanup fence before reconciliation; process restart does not replay business mutations
cache clear excludes sole offline originals; all-data scope explicitly includes them with warning
searchAndRead: paged metadata query, source private data bound to account
body decode off UI with bounded caches and per-query cancellation generation
SQLite FTS/Chinese strategy needs Android feature/size tests, do not silently remove existing searches
offline HTML no mailbox cookies/scripts/forms or automatic remote loads; export gets verified exact stored content
releaseBlockers: full schema field types and SQL constraints/transaction fixture validation
selective crypto framing and key custody/recovery
safe HTML reader and attachment/malicious input cases

doNotAddAgain: inline payload lengths already inside DB file length
message original lengths as actual disk usage
each duplicate message full stored object size
storageAccounting.meaning: native logical file lengths, not guaranteed filesystem physical blocks; original text total a separate logical-content metric
